note: Seventy-seven measured regions, all accounted: 23 figure rows, 3 recorded tables and 51 exclusions. The 51 are the eight text boxes of the Figure 18 flowchart and the six plus two arrangement thumbnails inside Tables 4 and 5, all `fragment-of-other`; one text-run band on p5; and the 34 regions of the two advertising sheets on p20-p21, which the paper itself announces on p19. Eleven of the twenty-three figures are polygon lattices, arrangement thumbnails or labelled sketches with no axes, no scale and no data, so they carry family `other` with an `other_note` naming what they draw [geometry.family].

Figures 3 and 5 are MATLAB perspective surfaces with a colour bar; Figures 20 to 22 render the same temperature field straight onto the pan cells with no axes and no bar. The first pair is surface-or-3D, the plates are heatmap-or-contour [geometry.colorbar].

Figures 1 and 23 each put two or three sub-plots of different kinds into one measured region (photograph beside a wireframe; line art above two surfaces), so both are composite-panel. Figures 8 and 13 repeat one kind and stay `other` with a panel count [geometry.panel_count].

Figure 7 plots ten measured observations as markers with the fitted straight line over them: the markers are the data and the line is the model, so the family follows the markers [geometry.data_labels].
